footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Suzano: after R$29.5M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 5.7% to R$50.1B in 2025. Gross margin was 32.4%, versus 42.2% a year earlier, and operating income fell 32.1% to R$10.6B, a 21.2% margin.

Net income was R$13.4B, or R$10.82 per share, after a R$7.1B loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was R$18.2B and free cash flow R$13.6B, versus R$11.4B; Suzano returned R$198M through dividends and buybacks.
highlights: Free cash flow rose 18.9% to R$13.6B.
watch: Cash ended the year at R$15.2B.
sources: Suzano S.A. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
